subject: Computer Networking
title: Browser Developer Tools
description: Learn Browser Developer Tools in one minute.

hook.text: Press F12 and a hidden world opens. DevTools let you inspect, debug, and profile any web page live.

buildup.text: The Elements panel shows live HTML and CSS. Edit styles in real time and see changes instantly.

discovery.text: The Network panel shows every HTTP request: timing, size, status code, and headers. Debug slow loads here.

twist.text: The Console runs JavaScript on the live page. Read variables, call functions, test snippets without reloading.

climax.text: Lighthouse audits performance, accessibility, and SEO. It scores your page and gives fix suggestions.

punchline.text: DevTools turn any browser into a web development lab. Free and built in.

quiz.question: What does the Network panel in DevTools show?
options: All HTTP requests with their timing and status codes
The page's HTML source code only
A list of installed browser extensions

details.summary: Browser developer tools inspect, debug, and profile web pages in real time. The Elements panel examines the DOM and CSS, the Network panel shows all HTTP traffic, the Console executes JavaScript, and the Performance panel identifies rendering bottlenecks.
details.whyItMatters: Developer tools are the most important debugging instrument for web developers. They provide deep visibility into every aspect of page behavior from DOM to network to performance.
takeaways: Elements panel inspects and edits DOM and CSS live
Network panel shows all requests with timing and response data
Performance panel identifies rendering and JavaScript bottlenecks

faq.question: What can you debug with the Network panel?
faq.answer: The Network panel shows every request the page makes including URL, method, status code, response time, and size. Waterfall charts reveal loading sequence and bottlenecks. You can inspect request and response headers, preview response bodies, simulate slow networks, and identify failed requests.

faq.question: How does the Performance panel work?
faq.answer: The Performance panel records CPU activity, rendering, and JavaScript execution over time. Flame charts show which functions consume the most time. Long tasks blocking the main thread are highlighted. Layout shifts and paint operations are visualized.
